en: Sepia-toned street view of a European city with a tramcar running along a narrow street lined with multi‑storey buildings and shop awnings. In the background rises a tall Baroque church tower with an onion-shaped dome. People are visible on the sidewalks. Faint printed caption text appears along the top margin, and additional small commercial signs and posters are visible on the right-hand buildings.
